switchMod.title: The $1 Dual K-Line Toggle Switch Mod
switchMod.summary: Unlock full-chassis diagnostics (ABS, Airbag, Alarm, Climate, Soft Top) for less than the cost of a coffee.
switchMod.whyNeeded: In early water-cooled Porsches (986 Boxster and 996 911), Porsche routed the Engine DME and Instrument Cluster to OBD Pin 7, but wired body and chassis systems (ABS/PSM, Airbag, Alarm, Climate, Soft Top) to OBD Pin 3. Standard Amazon cables only connect to Pin 7.
switchMod.pin7Modules: DME Engine Computer (0x11), Kombi Instrument Cluster (0x64), Tiptronic Transmission (0x18)
switchMod.pin3Modules: ABS 5.3/5.7 (0x1F), Alarm M534 (0xC0), Airbag POSIP (0x57), Climate HKL (0x98), Convertible Top (0x28)
instructions: Unscrew the blue transparent OBD connector shell of your VAG KKL cable.
Locate the internal wire running from the FTDI circuit board to OBD Pin 7.
Drill a small 3mm hole or cutout in the blue shell and mount an inexpensive SPDT miniature slide or toggle switch.
Connect the FTDI K-Line output wire to the switch center terminal, connect Position A to Pin 7, and Position B to Pin 3.
Alternatively: Solder a small wire jumper directly bridging Pin 7 and Pin 3 together (works on most cars without bus collision).

buyTips: Ensure listing explicitly specifies genuine FTDI (FT232RL or FT232RQ), NOT cheap CH340 or Prolific clone chips.
Search terms: 'VAG KKL 409.1 FTDI FT232RL USB OBD2'.
Auto-detected and configured by PeeweeSys over standard WebSerial.
